I rewrote `slugify` in `slug.py`, and all 6 tests in `test_slug.py` now pass. I didn't touch the tests.

The old version replaced every non-alphanumeric character with a hyphen and cut the result to `max_len`. That left repeated hyphens, hyphens at the ends, and dropped accented letters. The new version:
- Strips accents first, so "Café Déjà Vu" becomes "cafe-deja-vu".
- Collapses each run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen.
- Trims hyphens from both ends.
- Cuts to `max_len` and trims hyphens again, so a cut that lands on a hyphen doesn't leave one at the end.

Characters with no ASCII equivalent, such as Chinese or Cyrillic letters, are dropped entirely rather than transliterated. A title made only of those characters would give an empty slug. The tests don't cover this, so I left it as is.
